We need to issue the tool call correctly.

<thought>We will search the template catalog for templates that break a ketone functional group, with a larger limit (500) to increase chance of finding a Wolff‑Kishner reduction template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 500
}</action_input>
